verdict.rationale: The hosted Wally inference API is versioned at /v1 and has a pinned contract: an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec whose x-runanywhere-contract block pins the source schemas by sha256. That covers the versioning half of the story. The docs corpus explicitly contains no deprecation policy or changelog, and versioning covers only the cloud API, not the on-device SDKs. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, changelog/version history, sunset timelines or migration guidance, versioning guarantees for the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
